8. Housing Services  
1. Summary 
This Report is produced to give an overview of the delivery of the Housing Capital Programme 
and Housing Services at Westmeath County Council. The Report also covers the provision, 
maintenance and management of housing stock and the housing supports available for those 
who need them.  
 
The Report covers the following areas: 
 
Housing Capital Delivery 
Construction & Planned Delivery 
Affordable Housing Programme 
Croi Conaithe Scheme 
Acquisitions & Social Leasing 
Traveller Specific Accommodation

RAS, Leasing, HAP and Housing Allocations 
Housing Adaptation Grants 
Private Rented Housing Standards  
Local Authority Home Loan Scheme, Mortgage to Rent and the Tenant Purchase Scheme 
Housing Maintenance and Retrofit Scheme 
Homeless Services

of the effort to achieve the targets set by the Department of Housing, Local Government and 
Heritage (DHLGH). To this extent, the schemes are closely monitored from inception through 
to completion.  
The following tables provide an overview of the different schemes under the Housing 
Construction Capital Programme, their current status and estimated completion date.  
 
It should be noted that dates indicated for completion are estimates and are subject to

Plovers Wood, Kilnafaddoge 
 
Development Agreement signed on 16th December 2024 with Alanna Homes for the delivery of a 576 Housing Scheme at Plovers Wood, 
Kilnafaddoge with Department Approval for 174 social units (30%). Access Road to be delivered in Phase 1 with support from the Local 
Infrastructure Housing Activation Fund (LIHAF).  Construction is expected to commence in Q1 2025.

8. Vacant Property Refurbishment Grant 
The Croí Cónaithe (Towns) Fund in the form of the Vacant Property Refurbishment Grant provides 
further opportunities for people to live in towns and villages in Westmeath through the provision of 
a grant to support the refurbishment of vacant properties, with priority given to areas where the 
level of vacancy or dereliction is high. 
As at the 31st January 2025: 
• Number of applications – 240 
• Funding Issued – 61 
• Approved (Invoices received and at the legal charge stage) – 65 
• Approved in Principle (1st Inspection complete and works approved) – 105 
• Further Information requested – 68 
• Rejected/withdrawn – 15

9. Acquisitions Programme 
Circular 06/2024 outlines the revised arrangements for social housing acquisitions for 2024. Social 
housing acquisitions will continue to focus on priority categories and properties where a tenant is in 
receipt of social housing supports, including HAP and RAS, and has received a valid Notice of 
Termination (NoT) due to the landlord’s intention to sell the property.  
 
Westmeath County Council acquired 46 units in 2024. have not yet received confirmation of the 
allocation for 2025.

10. Ongoing Construction Projects  
Ongoing discussions with Developers/Property Owners/AHBs with regard to support for various sites 
throughout the county under Social Housing Leasing Programme. 
 
Oakcrest, Mullingar (PL 18-6261) – 8 units approved by DHPLG- 5 units completed. Carparking 
proposed on the site for completed units. 
 
Austin Friar’s Street, Mullingar (PL 20-6156) – 6 Units approved by DHLGH. 2 Units completed. 
Awaiting updated costs for remaining 4 units to be submitted to DHLGH for approval.    A conditional 
grant of planning permission for 5 units was approved by ABP.  We are awaiting costs for same to be 
submitted to DHLGH for approval. 
 
11. Traveller Accommodation 
 
Blackberry Lane, Athlone - Redevelopment of the site to include 41 new units. Stage 2 approval was 
received from the Department in May 2023. This project is currently at preplanning stage.  
 
The Traveller Accommodation Programme 2025-2029 was adopted by the Elected Members at the 
December Council meeting. 
 
The Traveller Accommodation Programme target for 2025 for all social housing supports is 26 
households.  To date 5 Approved Housing Body offers were made, up to 31st January 2025.   
 
12. Housing Supports and Services 
The Housing Section continues to provide a wide range of Housing Supports to Social Housing 
Applicants to Social Housing Tenants.  Westmeath County Council completed the Summary of Social 
Housing Assessments (SSHA) under S.21 of the Housing (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 2009 by the 
deadline of 4th November 2024. 
 
13. Housing Maintenance: 
Managing housing maintenance county wide, ensuring value for money while adhering to response 
times set in Tenant handbook. The Midlands Retroﬁt Programme was completed in 2023.
